jobs.description: Job RequirementsDo you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including clinicians, engineers, communicators and external partners, to drive successful adoption of our products in the market.Choose the best place for your work - Within the scope of this position, it is possible, in consultation with your manager, to work mobile (within Germany) up to an average volume of 60% of the respective working hours.Even more flexibility? Mobile working from abroad is possible for up to 30 days a year under certain conditions and in selected countries.Your tasks and responsibilities:•As Marketing Manager you drive business growth and lead global outbound marketing activities for our MRI systems with 1.5T Tesla field strength and 70cm bore size, particularly MAGNETOM Flow. Platform (70cm).•You are responsible for driving the creation and implementation of marketing strategies for cross-portfolio initiatives centered around 'BioMatrix', our latest technology to adapt MRI examinations to patients' biovariability, as well as marketing activities around e.g. energy efficiency.•You enable outstanding customer experience within your area of responsibility, encompassing online product representation, development of marketing and sales support materials, as well as both virtual and in-person customer engagements.•You advise on all marketing-related topics for your segment and echo market needs into the organization, in close collaboration with solution owners.•You are responsible for defining and validating marketing claims in context of the release process for medical products (CE / FDA clearance).•You adopt and implement (digital) marketing guidelines, programs, and standards into the organizational unit.•You conduct market research and support in determining effective pricing, bundling and positioning structures.
